natural_query: Help the elderly resident use the stairs safely.

source_evidence.evidence_text:
When the animal approaches its muzzle to the bowl (equipped with a level sensor), which will contain the food; if this is not full, it activates at the times that the user has selected from the app. 
17; elderly stairs; When the elderly user approaches the stairlift AND sits on it, equipped with a pressure detector, DO activates, greets and goes down or up the stairs.
evidence_limits: does not establish deployment or successful use
does not establish persistence, accountability, failure meaning, or release unless explicit in text
supports desired behavior but not population prevalence

curator_rationale: The ledger row concatenates unrelated pet-feeding and stair-mobility text, so the stair responsibility cannot be cleanly traced to an auditable evidence unit.
